title: Alegia · San Juan kalea
description: The Basque village from map data (just geo alegia, docs/places/alegia.md): number 95 and its arcade, the old street with its named houses, the town hall square with the real facade and the clock turret, Zubi Zaharra and the weir over the sunk Oria, Txintxarri plaza's stone cowbell, the playground's pelota wall, the valley's hills, and the drizzle.
